subject.title: Autoreview rejects safe provider credential references and test placeholders

question: Should autoreview trust the exact provider/session member expressions and explicit test-placeholder values proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/agent-skills/pull/103?
rationale: These exceptions are intentionally narrow, but approving new values that bypass a fail-closed credential scanner is a security-boundary choice that source inspection alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve the exact allowlist
options.body: Accept only the enumerated runtime references and test placeholders, with positive and negative regression coverage plus representative bundle proof.

options.title: Narrow the accepted values
options.body: Approve only a smaller subset after identifying which provider/session expressions and fixture values are required by current downstream code.

options.title: Keep the current boundary
options.body: Reject the exceptions and require affected source code or fixtures to use already-supported reference and placeholder forms.

recommendation.title: Approve the exact allowlist
recommendation.body: Accept only the enumerated runtime references and test placeholders, with positive and negative regression coverage plus representative bundle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current scanner and its recent security hardening predominantly originate from this contributor's merged history.
